page.layout: One text column with a running head and page number at the top; left margin holds three small notes ("Crux omnia amplexa."); at the foot, a chapter catchline "Cap." and two footnotes in small type.

main_text.p: cubitorum posuit 1, sed ipsi ascendendam. Sanè pleræque omnes altiusculæ, atque ideò communiter Tertullianus 1: Timebit forsitan caro gladium gravem, aut crucem excelsam. Quam ipsam rationem Lactantius 2 in Dominica assignat. Nam quoniam, inquit, is qui patibulo suspenditur, & confixus est omnibus, & ceteris altior: crux potius electa est, qua significaret illum tam conspicuum tamque sublimem futurum, ut ad eum cognoscendum pariter & colendum cunctæ nationes ex omni orbe Crux omnia amplexa. concurrerent. O inopinatam, sed veram dictionem! cui fides maximè nostro ævo facta: cùm, virtute & gloriâ magnâ Hispanicæ gentis, Novus etiam orbis venit in Christianas leges.

page.notes: Left margin notes are read as "Crux / omnia / amplexa." The superscript note marks in the text are small and partly unclear; the footnote numerals are reconstructed from the printed marks. Catchword "Cap." is the chapter-end signal, set in larger type. Some ink and show-through at the edges is not transcribed.
